title: Ned and the Plum
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 3 — Phase 4: CCVCC words: two consonant sounds at the start and two at the end (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 60-sound stage (gl, gr, pl just added).

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling standing on green grass under a fruit tree near the bird table.
A ripe purple plum falling from a branch above, Ned looking up at it.

pages.text: Ned has a peck at the plum.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling pecking at the purple plum lying on the grass.
Close view of the purple plum, its skin broken and juice glistening where Ned has pecked it.
Ned the duckling pulling back from the plum with a wide, happy grin.

pages.text: Ned can grab a bit for Nell.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling picking up a small piece of the plum in his bill to carry to Nell.

pages.text: Ned can grab a bit for Fig.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling picking up a second small piece of the plum to carry to Fig.

pages.text: Some of the plum is for Ned. Some is for pals.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling, Nell the bee and Fig the caterpillar each with a small piece of the purple plum.

pages.text: Ned is glad. Ned had fun.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling sitting happily on the grass with Nell and Fig, the plum shared between them.
